```{r}
#------- import data -------#
# NOTE: run asv_curation_16S.R first -- it produces
# results/tax_filled_2023_16S.csv, which is what this chunk reads below.

# Sequence count table (path relative to repository root)
otutab2 <- read.csv("data/asv_otu_rl_2023_16S.csv", check.names = F)
rownames(otutab2)<- otutab2[,1]
otutab2 <- otutab2[,2:46]
otutab2 <- otu_table(otutab2, taxa_are_rows = T)

# Sequence taxonomy classifications -- curated (Taxa-filled) table produced
# by asv_curation_16S.R, NOT the raw data/asv_tax_rl_2023_16S.csv (which
# has one fewer column: no filled "Taxa" field).
tax2 <- read.csv("results/tax_filled_2023_16S.csv", header=T)
rownames(tax2)<- taxa_names(otutab2)
tax2 <- tax2[,2:9]
tax2 <- as.matrix(tax2)
tax2 <- tax_table(tax2)
taxa_names(tax2) <- taxa_names(otutab2)

# Sample metadata -- data/ossining_meta.csv is the correct source, but its
# SampleID/Date columns need massaging into a name that matches the ASV
# table's sample columns, plus a Month factor and an ordered Date_Sam factor
# used later in this Rmd. See metadata_utils.R for exactly how each derived
# column is built.
source("metadata_utils.R")
meta2 <- load_ossining_meta("data/ossining_meta.csv")
meta2 <- meta2[meta2$Year == 2023, ]
meta2 <- make_sample_name(meta2, domain_prefix = "16S", name_col = "Name")
meta2 <- sample_data(meta2)
rownames(meta2) <- meta2$Name
# Load table, tax, and metadata into phyloseq object
physeq_16S23 <- merge_phyloseq(otutab2, tax2, meta2)

# remove samples with zero counts
physeq_16S23 <- prune_samples(sample_sums(physeq_16S23) >= 1, physeq_16S23)

# remove chloroplasts
physeq_16S23 <- subset_taxa(physeq_16S23, Order!="Chloroplast")
```

```{r}
#------- alpha diversity measures -------#
library("microbiome")
library("knitr")
alpha16S23 <- microbiome::alpha(physeq_16S23)
write.csv(alpha16S23, "results/ossining23-16S_alpha-diversity-2.csv")

#------- plot richness -------#
jpeg("figs/richplot16S23-2.jpg",width = 10, height =8, units = "in", res = 300)
plot_richness(physeq_16S23, x = "Date_Sam", measures="Observed") +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_bw() + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=60, hjust=1)) + 
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 14))+
  theme(axis.title.x=element_blank())
dev.off()

rich.plot_16S23 <- plot_richness(physeq_16S23, x = "Date_Sam", measures="Observed") +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_bw() + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=60, hjust=1)) + 
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 14))+
  theme(axis.title.x=element_blank())

jpeg("figs/richplot16S_23_lake-2.jpg",width = 10, height =8, units = "in", res = 300)
plot_richness(physeq_16S23, x = "Date_Sam", measures="Observed", title = "16S 2023 richness") +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_bw() + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=60, hjust=1)) + 
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 14))+
  theme(axis.title.x=element_blank()) +facet_grid(.~Lake, scales="free")
dev.off()

#------- Phylum bar plot -------#
p_16S23 <- subset_taxa(physeq_16S23) %>%
  tax_glom(taxrank = "Phylum") %>%                     #agglomerate to phylum level
  transform_sample_counts(function(x){x/sum(x)}) %>%   #transform to relative abundance
  psmelt()
write.csv(p_16S23, "results/ossining23-16S_phylum-2.csv")

library(dplyr)
relabund_table_16S2023Phylum <- p_16S23 %>%
  group_by(Lake, Month, Date_Sam, Phylum) %>%
  summarize(RelAbund = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop")

write.csv(relabund_table_16S2023Phylum,
          "results/ossining23-16S_relative_abundance_phylum-2.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

#------- Build a master color palette based on 2023 data -------#
#library(RColorBrewer)
#library(dplyr)
#library(ggplot2)

# Get all unique phyla from the 2023 dataset (the reference)
all_phyla_2023 <- sort(unique(p_16S23$Phylum))

# Create the palette sized to the 2023 phyla count
getPalette <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12, "Paired"))
phylum_colors <- setNames(getPalette(length(all_phyla_2023)), all_phyla_2023)
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------#

phyplot_16S23 <- ggplot(arrange(p_16S23, Phylum), aes(x=Date_Sam, y=Abundance, fill=Phylum)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(size=10, hjust = 0.5), 
        legend.text=element_text(size=10)) +
  ylab("Relative Read Abundance") +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 10))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = phylum_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1), expand = c(0,0))+
  guides(fill=guide_legend(ncol = 2))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust=1))

phyplot_16S23 +facet_grid(.~Lake, scales="free")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(size = 9))

#SAVE PLOTS:
jpeg("figs/phyplot16S23-2.jpg",width = 10, height =8, units = "in", res = 300)
ggplot(arrange(p_16S23, Phylum), aes(x=Date_Sam, y=Abundance, fill=Phylum)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(size=10, hjust = 0.5), 
        legend.text=element_text(size=10)) +
  ylab("Relative Read Abundance") +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 10))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = phylum_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1), expand = c(0,0))+
  guides(fill=guide_legend(ncol = 2))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust=1))
dev.off()

jpeg("figs/lake_phyplot16S23-2.jpg",width = 12, height =8, units = "in", res = 300)
phyplot_16S23 +facet_grid(.~Lake, scales="free")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(size = 9)) + plot_annotation ("16S 2023 Relative Read Abundance")
dev.off()

#save as svg
ggsave("figs/lake_phyplot16S_23-2.svg",width = 12, height =8, units = "in")
phyplot_16S23 +facet_grid(.~Lake, scales="free")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(size = 9)) + plot_annotation ("16S 2023 Relative Read Abundance")
dev.off()
```

```{r}
LM_16S23
#phyloseq-class experiment-level object
#otu_table()   OTU Table:         [ 7420 taxa and 15 samples ]
#sample_data() Sample Data:       [ 15 samples by 13 sample variables ]
#tax_table()   Taxonomy Table:    [ 7420 taxa by 8 taxonomic ranks ]

#scale to even depth
LM_16S23rare <- rarefy_even_depth(LM_16S23)
LM_16S23rare
#phyloseq-class experiment-level object
#otu_table()   OTU Table:         [ 3317 taxa and 15 samples ]
```

```{r}
#------PERMANOVA--------#
#FOR MOHEGAN
#bray curtis on rarified physeq
LMbray16S23 <- phyloseq::distance(LM_16S23rare, method="bray")
#make physeq a data frame
LMdf16S23 <- data.frame(sample_data(LM_16S23rare))
#PERMANOVA with bray curtis in formula and data as dataframe
LMperm16S23 <- adonis2(LMbray16S23~Month, data=LMdf16S23)
#check output
LMperm16S23
#significant!

#FOR RIPPOWAM
#bray curtis on rarified physeq
LRbray16S23 <- phyloseq::distance(LR_16S23rare, method="bray")
#make physeq a data frame
LRdf16S23 <- data.frame(sample_data(LR_16S23rare))
#PERMANOVA with bray curtis in formula and data as dataframe
LRperm16S23 <- adonis2(LRbray16S23~Month, data=LRdf16S23)
#check output
LRperm16S23
#significant!

#FOR TEATOWN
#bray curtis on rarified physeq
TTLbray16S23 <- phyloseq::distance(TTL_16S23rare, method="bray")
#make physeq a data frame
TTLdf16S23 <- data.frame(sample_data(TTL_16S23rare))
#PERMANOVA with bray curtis in formula and data as dataframe
TTLperm16S23 <- adonis2(TTLbray16S23~Month, data=TTLdf16S23)
#check output
TTLperm16S23
#significant!

#-----Cyano PERMANOVA-----
#FOR MOHEGAN
#bray curtis on rarified physeq
cLMbray16S23 <- phyloseq::distance(LMcbrare_16S23, method="bray")
#make physeq a data frame
cLMdf16S23 <- data.frame(sample_data(LMcbrare_16S23))
```

```{r}
#PAIRWISE TESTING FOLLOWING PERMANOVA

#LM,LR,TTL significant -> pairwise comparison post hoc
```

```{r}
#------HOMOGENEITY OF MULTIVARIATE DISPERSION (PERMDISP)------#
# Run this BEFORE trusting each PERMANOVA result above
# if significant, run TukeyHSD()

#FOR MOHEGAN
LMdisp16S23 <- betadisper(LMbray16S23, LMdf16S23$Month)
permutest(LMdisp16S23, permutations = 999)
# not significant

#FOR RIPPOWAM
LRdisp16S23 <- betadisper(LRbray16S23, LRdf16S23$Month)
permutest(LRdisp16S23, permutations = 999)
# not significant

#FOR TEATOWN
TTLdisp16S23 <- betadisper(TTLbray16S23, TTLdf16S23$Month)
permutest(TTLdisp16S23, permutations = 999)
# not significant

#ALL LAKES: physeq_16S23
#Lake23perm16 used Lake*Month, so check dispersion for EACH factor separately
#betadisper only takes one grouping factor at a time

#dispersion by Lake
Lake2316Sdisp_Lake <- betadisper(Lake23bray16, Lake23df16$Lake)
permutest(Lake2316Sdisp_Lake, permutations = 999)
# SIGNIFICANT
TukeyHSD(Lake2316Sdisp_Lake)
#TTL/LR significant

#dispersion by Month
Lake2316Sdisp_Month <- betadisper(Lake23bray16, Lake23df16$Month)
permutest(Lake2316Sdisp_Month, permutations = 999)
# not significant

#dispersion by the Lake:Month interaction (combine factors into one grouping variable)
Lake23df16$LakeMonth <- interaction(Lake23df16$Lake, Lake23df16$Month)
Lake2316Sdisp_LakeMonth <- betadisper(Lake23bray16, Lake23df16$LakeMonth)
permutest(Lake2316Sdisp_LakeMonth, permutations = 999)
# not significant

#------ CYANO HOMOGENEITY OF MULTIVARIATE DISPERSION (PERMDISP)------#
# Run this BEFORE trusting each PERMANOVA result above
# if significant, run TukeyHSD

#FOR MOHEGAN
cLMdisp16S23 <- betadisper(cLMbray16S23, cLMdf16S23$Month)
permutest(cLMdisp16S23, permutations = 999)
# not significant

#FOR RIPPOWAM
cLRdisp16S23 <- betadisper(cLRbray16S23, cLRdf16S23$Month)
permutest(cLRdisp16S23, permutations = 999)
# not significant

#FOR TEATOWN
cTTLdisp16S23 <- betadisper(cTTLbray16S23, cTTLdf16S23$Month)
permutest(cTTLdisp16S23, permutations = 999)
# not significant

#ALL LAKES: 
#cLake23perm16 used Lake*Month, so check dispersion for EACH factor separately
#betadisper only takes one grouping factor at a time

#dispersion by Lake (main effect)
cLake23disp_Lake <- betadisper(cLake23bray, cLake23df$Lake)
permutest(cLake23disp_Lake, permutations = 999)
# not significant

#dispersion by Month (main effect)
cLake23disp_Month <- betadisper(cLake23bray, cLake23df$Month)
permutest(cLake23disp_Month, permutations = 999)
# not significant

#dispersion by Lake:Month interaction (combined factor)
cLake23df$LakeMonth <- interaction(cLake23df$Lake, cLake23df$Month)
cLake23disp_LakeMonth <- betadisper(cLake23bray, cLake23df$LakeMonth)
permutest(cLake23disp_LakeMonth, permutations = 999)
# not significant

```
